IMPORTANT NUANCE FOUND DURING RESEARCH: an older Instagram carousel graphic (post DXMKdazjV-1, slide 9/9) displays 'BOOK ONLINE luxebeautyheadspa.com' as if it were a live option -- this is aspirational/outdated marketing copy from the business itself, NOT a live site (domain still does not resolve). The Instagram bio external_url and every current booking link point exclusively to Fresha. luxebeautyheadspa.glossgenius.com (a platform subdomain, which per pipeline rules does not count as an owned site even if live) now redirects to the generic glossgenius.com homepage, i.e. it is decommissioned too. Conclusion: no independently-owned live website.

brand_vibe: Actual logo (Instagram profile picture, sampled directly): cream/off-white background (#f1ede2) with fine taupe/mocha line-art (minimalist lotus-flower + face silhouette, sampled line color ~#8e887c-#a89f93) and an elegant thin serif wordmark 'LUXE BEAUTY / HEAD SPA | BLOWOUTBAR | SKIN STUDIO'. Fresha's own venue photography (10 professional interior photos, no text/people) shows a warm, light, quiet-luxury studio: cream/white walls, wood floors, boho rattan egg chair, brass/gold hoop floor lamp, sage-green paneled facial room -- a light base, NOT dark. The business's Instagram Reels/carousel marketing graphics use a separate near-black+gold Canva template (common generic social-media template distinct from the actual brand identity/logo/physical space), so that was not used for the palette. Chose the LIGHT template (Amani-style tokens) with an accent derived from the sampled logo taupe/mocha rather than the reels' dark template.

curation_notes: Downloaded 25 Instagram media (12 posts expanded, incl. 2 sidecars) + 10 Fresha gallery photos = 35 raw files, all verified valid with `file`. Nearly all Instagram Reels/carousel images have Canva-style captions baked into the image (text overlays), which the pipeline prohibits in the gallery -- only 1 of 25 Instagram images (the video poster used as hero-1.jpg) had zero on-image text. All 10 Fresha photos are clean professional interior shots with no text and no people, so gallery + experience images were sourced primarily from Fresha. No selfies or mid-procedure faces with closed eyes were used in the gallery.
